subject: maths
question:
The given pie chart shows the degree-wise break-up of the expenditure of a family in a month. The total expenditure of the family is ₹43,200.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2c94fccddd811eb99021bd7e174ddc1a4f8476a3a5cda5ad93fa046cef1a631.png] 

By what percentage is the expenditure on education and rent taken together more than the expenditure on food (correct to two decimal places)?
solution:
**Given:**

Expenditure on education = 60º

Expenditure on rent = 70º

Expenditure on food = 105º

**Calculation:**

Total expenditure on education and rent = 60º + 70º = 130º

Difference = 130º - 105º = 25º

Difference % = 25over 105 × 100 = 23.81%

∴ **The answer is 23.81%.**
